summary: A semantic thematic break, rendered as a real <hr>.
useWhen: separating groups of content or controls that are related but distinct
a menu, toolbar or form needs a visible section break

useInstead.when: you only want space between two things
useInstead.why: a rule announces a break to a screen reader; whitespace does not, and usually shouldn't

vertical.use: inside a horizontal row: toolbars, button groups, header bars

guarantees: `<hr>` is a thematic break to assistive tech without needing a role
`aria-orientation="vertical"` is set for the vertical case — the one thing a screen reader cannot infer from the element

antiPatterns.why: that is what this component exists to replace

antiPatterns.dont: a Divider between every row of a list
antiPatterns.why: a break announced on every row is noise; use the list's own row borders
